people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”
translations.bsb: “We have sinned,” the Israelites said to the LORD. “Deal with us as You see fit; but please deliver us today!”
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel said unto Jehovah, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; only deliver us, we pray thee, this day.
